title: An own-save re-read after another device's erase shows the new record's values beside the old record's form until the erase's own remote signal applies
evidence: Root fix R13 PR 4 (2026-11-25), US-34 AC10: the own-save values read is checked against the erase shown (useRecordApply signal, the values branch: getEraseIdentity against erase.getSnapshot().shown); under another erase it writes nothing (useRecordReads reloadValues, a null ShownCopy), and the erase's own signal reads the new record. Pin flipped: useRecordApply.test.tsx "US-34 AC4a (today, fix 4 owns erase events)" became "US-34 AC10 (H16)". Tests: useRecordApply.test, useRecordReads.test.
